cards.title: My son is leaving home for university – and my severe denial has surprised me
cards.body: A parent grapples with empty nest syndrome as their eldest prepares for university. The emotional challenge of this major life transition reveals how unprepared we can be for natural milestones.

cards.title: I thought having a second baby would be easier – but I've forgotten so much
cards.body: A parent discovers that having a second child revives forgotten challenges around feeding, teething, and development. The experience reshapes memories of their own childhood and parenting expectations.

cards.title: Parenting is hard. Should we let AI do it for us?
cards.body: Tech companies offer parents eye-movement trackers, personalized podcasts, and optimized nap predictions. The article questions whether parents actually need these tools for raising children.

cards.title: Should I try the '18 summers' parenting trend?
cards.body: Modern parenting trends push parents to optimize summer holidays into 'making memories' exercises. The author argues that long unstructured days are the actual point of childhood summers.

cards.title: Overparenting: When giving is really a form of taking
cards.body: Parenting becomes controlling when care serves a parent's need to be needed over a child's growing autonomy. Healthy parenting offers connection while providing room for children to grow.

cards.title: Are teens and parents ready for back to school without cell phones?
cards.body: Many schools are implementing phone-free school days as families prepare for a new academic year. Schools will need parental support to make this transition successful.

cards.title: The intersection of motherhood, mental health, and addiction
cards.body: Women continue to face stigma and barriers when seeking mental health and addiction care. The article explores what needs to change to better support mothers struggling with these issues.

cards.title: Are you living under your adult child's weather?
cards.body: Parents of adult children often learn to read their emotional states through subtle cues. Managing your adult child's emotional wellbeing shouldn't become a full-time parental job.

cards.title: Scientists stunned by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
cards.body: Children's lung capacity caught up with their peers in less polluted areas after a clean air zone was introduced. The study demonstrates the significant impact of air quality on child development.

cards.title: Living with parents as a young adult: the unexpected bonus
cards.body: Beyond saving money, young adults living with parents gain unexpected psychological and relational benefits. The arrangement can reshape family dynamics in positive ways.
